copy.curiosityHook: As an outbreak unleashes pure cruelty across the city, can two people hold onto their sanity long enough to find one another alive?
copy.description: Amid a sudden viral pandemic, the streets descend into sadistic violence and madness. Rob Jabbaz directs as a separated young couple attempts to reunite while infected citizens carry out unspeakable depravities.
copy.vibeSummary: Unrelenting, brutally heavy horror fueled by rapid escalation, intense suspense, and an overwhelming sense of collapse.
copy.whyWatch: Director Rob Jabbaz takes a familiar infection premise and drives it into punishing, fast-paced territory, turning a couple's desperate reunion into a tense survival gauntlet.

allowedMaterial: viral pandemic causing cruelty and depravity
separated young couple attempting to reunite
fast pace, heavy emotional weight, suspenseful tone
excludedMaterial: ultimate survival or fate of the couple
origin or cure of the virus
